name: POV Water Slide
summary: Turns a time of day, environment, weather, LED colour, slide route, ending and duration into one finished photorealistic text-to-video prompt for the viral first-person POV water-slide format: a vertigo reveal into the drop, a committing hop, then a continuous descent to a splashdown.
use_when: The user wants a POV water slide video, a skyscraper or cliff slide clip, a vertigo or fear-of-heights POV ride, a transparent LED slide descending a tower, mountain, canyon or waterfall, or wants to recreate the 'would never go down that' first-person slide format in a new environment.
produces: One finished photorealistic first-person text-to-video prompt for a continuous-take POV water-slide descent, from the edge to the splashdown.
